independent_review.scope: canonical read-only suite followed conditionally by one separately authorized retained no-solver probe

mandatory_conditions: Extract and replay exactly the 48 unique v12-v15 preserved artifact paths and hashes from the v26 canonical test constants.
Use a fresh private 0700 host directory bound to /tmp, read-only root, cleared environment, and dropped capabilities.
Set PLANORA_MUNI_V26_SKIP_HEAVY=1 and stage no official input, progress, checkpoint, solution, or derivation-audit-only probe payload.
Require two MemAvailable samples of at least 1900000 KiB at least five seconds apart with no competing heavy WSL workload.
Execute once and accept only 117 passes, exactly two intentional heavy-test skips, and zero failures or errors.
Retain stdout, stderr, exit status, hashes, staging inventory, and post-exit cleanup evidence.
